title: José Hernández and the Repeated Application
short_teaser: José Hernández applied to NASA many times before being selected as an astronaut, strengthening his skills between attempts.
story: José Hernández applied to NASA many times before being selected as an astronaut, strengthening his skills between attempts. Persistence is strongest when each attempt includes learning and preparation. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
